content.stem: 联合国制定制裁制度的主要目标包括:(选择三项.)

options.A: 强迫发展中国家采用自由民主或实质民主.
options.B: 支持各国政府和政权和平解决冲突.
options.C: 对那些在金融犯罪管控方面存在薄弱环节的政府进行惩罚.
options.D: 遏制各国境内非民主和违宪的权力变更.

content.stem_en: The primary objectives of the United Nations in developing sanctions regimes include: (Select Three.)

options_en.A: To force developing nations to adopt liberal or substantive democracies
options_en.B: To support governments and regimes in the peaceful resolution of conflict
options_en.C: To punish governments for having weak financial crime controls
options_en.D: To deter non-democratic and unconstitutional changes within countries
options_en.E: To support the protection of human rights
